title: Iran attacks US bases in Middle East after reports US strike killed five at wedding party
content: The Iranian Red Crescent says a child was among those killed when shrapnel from a US strike hit a home. The US military says it is aware of the reports and it never targets civilians.

title: Zelensky says airlines should avoid Russian airspace as Ukraine escalates drone operations
content: Chinese and Gulf state airlines are among those still using Russian airspace. Meanwhile, Russia says it will intensify its own attacks on Ukraine.

title: Israel expanding presence in Lebanon, officials say, as BBC visits occupied areas
content: A BBC team joined a humanitarian mission of the UN peacekeeping force, which says Israeli troops are fortifying positions and continuing demolitions.

content: Visa cancellations or delays have forced international artists to rethink US tours under President Donald Trump.

title: Syria’s restrained approach to Israel carries risks
content: Damascus's restraint could encourage more Israeli encroachment and lose the trust of the Syrian public.

title: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in national security case
content: Pro-democracy activist faces life sentence in second case under Beijing's national security law.
